title: PaymentTransferRequest
description: JSON-RPC params for transferring captured funds to the seller. V1 records the transfer as an evy.transactions row with type "transfer". In real mode (STRIPE_MOCK=false with a real sk_test_ key), creates a Stripe Connect transfer to STRIPE_CONNECT_ACCOUNT_ID; per-seller destination accounts will arrive with seller onboarding. Mock mode stays deterministic and local.
